pages.text: Some of the fruit grown in the mod can be turned into jam.$(br2)It's a fairly simple way of getting another use out of berries and cherries once you've got a decent harvest.

pages.title: Jams
pages.text: There are three jams: Blackberry Jam, Blueberry Jam and Cherry Jam.$(br2)Each jam is made from its corresponding fruit and sugar.
Recipes:$(br)Blackberry Jam: Blackberry + Sugar$(br)Blueberry Jam: Blueberry + Sugar$(br)Cherry Jam: Cherry + Sugar
